name: Glovebox — Car Insurance Manager
description: A warm, editorial landing page for Glovebox, an AI that manages car insurance: a pinned hero whose footage a clip-path closes in on while the camera zooms to the centre, three blurred-video feature cards dealt one under the next with live task panels, a pinned statistic with work drifting past it, a dot map of members with stories sliding over it, how it works, FAQ and a closing frame that clips open.
designedFor: Insurance, fintech and admin-automation products that want a calm, human, serif-led page
Showing scroll-driven clip-path and video-zoom effects as editor-ready components
Product pages that show an AI working through live task panels rather than describing it
